(
    ID                  BIGINT NOT NULL

    ,UserName	        nvarchar(200) NOT NULL 
    ,UserGroup	        nvarchar(100) NOT NULL
    ,UserEmail	        nvarchar(60) NOT NULL

    ,ValidEndDttm	    datetime	NULL

    select
    UserID as UserID

    ,UserGroup as UserGroup
    ,UserEmail as UserEmail

    ,[Data Layer] as datalayer
    ,0 as WorkFlowId
    ,0 as TaskRunId

    FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurity_TEST_20231004 
)
---------AUDIT
INSERT INTO dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit (Id,UserID,UserName,UserGroup,UserEmail,BankID,SourceSystemCode,ValidStartDttm,ValidEndDttm,WorkFlowId,TaskRunId,InsertDttm,DimensionChksm)

SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY UserID) + (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ID),0) ID FROM  dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit) Id
,UserID
,UserName
,UserGroup
,UserEmail
,BankID
,SourceSystemCode
,ValidStartDttm
,ValidEndDttm
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
,DimensionChksm

from
(
  MERGE INTO dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit AS target
  -- The source must be defined with the USING clause
  USING 
  (
    -- The source is made up of the attribute columns from the staging table.
    select
     ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY UserID) + (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ID),0) ID FROM  dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit) as Id
    ,UserID as UserID
    ,UserName as UserName
    ,UserGroup as UserGroup
    ,UserEmail as UserEmail
    ,BankID as BankID
    ,SourceSystemCode as SourceSystemCode
    ,Datalayer as datalayer
    ,getdate() as ValidStartDttm
    ,'9999-12-31'	as ValidEndDttm
    ,WorkFlowId as WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId as TaskRunId
    ,getdate() as InsertDttm
    ,BINARY_CHECKSUM(UserName,UserGroup,BankID,SourceSystemCode,datalayer) as DimensionChksm
    FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurity_TEST_20231004 
  ) AS source 
  --( 
  --   UserID
  --  ,UserName
  --  ,UserGroup
  --  ,UserEmail
  --  ,BankID
  --  ,SourceSystemCode
  --  ,ValidStartDttm
  --  ,ValidEndDttm
  --  ,WorkFlowId
  --  ,TaskRunId
  --  ,InsertDttm
  --  ,DimensionChksm
  --) 
  ON --We are matching on the SourceSystemID in the target table and the source table.
  ( target.UserID = source.UserID
    AND target.UserEmail = source.UserEmail)
  
  
  WHEN MATCHED and target.DimensionChksm <> source.DimensionChksm 
                                 and target.ValidEndDttm='9999-12-31'
  THEN 
  UPDATE SET 
    ValidEndDttm=getdate()-1,  
    InsertDttm=getdate()

  WHEN NOT MATCHED BY target THEN  
  INSERT 
  (
    Id,UserID,UserName,UserGroup,UserEmail,BankID,SourceSystemCode,Datalayer,ValidStartDttm,ValidEndDttm,WorkFlowId,TaskRunId,InsertDttm,DimensionChksm
  )
  VALUES 
  (
    source.Id
    ,source.UserID
    ,source.UserName
    ,source.UserGroup
    ,source.UserEmail
    ,source.BankID
    ,source.SourceSystemCode
    ,source.Datalayer
    ,source.ValidStartDttm
    ,source.ValidEndDttm
    ,source.WorkFlowId
    ,source.TaskRunId
    ,source.InsertDttm
    ,source.DimensionChksm
  );
  OUTPUT $action 
     UserID
    ,UserName
    ,UserGroup
    ,UserEmail
    ,BankID
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,getdate()
    ,'9999-12-31'
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,getdate()
    ,DimensionChksm
); -- the end of the merge statement
--The changes output below are the records that have changed and will need
--to be inserted into the slowly changing dimension.
as changes 
(
    action
    ,UserID
    ,UserName
    ,UserGroup
    ,UserEmail
    ,BankID
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,ValidStartDttm
    ,ValidEndDttm
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
    ,DimensionChksm
)
where action='UPDATE';




CREATE PROCEDURE DW.SP_RefRowLevelSecurityAudit
AS BEGIN

WITH SRC AS (
    select
    UserID as UserID
    ,UserName as UserName
    ,UserGroup as UserGroup
    ,UserEmail as UserEmail
    ,BankID as BankID
    ,SourceSystemCode as SourceSystemCode
    ,Datalayer as datalayer
    ,getdate() as ValidStartDttm
    ,'9999-12-31'	as ValidEndDttm
    ,WorkFlowId as WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId as TaskRunId
    ,getdate() as InsertDttm
    ,BINARY_CHECKSUM(UserName,UserGroup,BankID,SourceSystemCode,datalayer) as DimensionChksm
    FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurity_TEST_20231004  
)
SELECT * INTO #SRC FROM SRC;

WITH TGT AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT * FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit WHERE ValidEndDttm = '9999-12-31'
)
, DELTA AS (
    SELECT S.UserID, S.UserEmail,S.BankID,S.SourceSystemCode, S.DimensionChksm as src_dchksm, T.DimensionChksm as tgt_dchksm,
    CASE WHEN T.DimensionChksm IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
         WHEN S.DimensionChksm <> T.DimensionChksm THEN 'UPDATE'
         ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #SRC S
    LEFT JOIN TGT T ON S.UserID = T.UserID AND S.UserEmail = T.UserEmail AND S.UserName = T.UserName AND S.UserGroup = T.UserGroup AND S.BankID = T.BankID  AND S.SourceSystemCode = T.SourceSystemCode 
    WHERE T.DimensionChksm IS NULL OR S.DimensionChksm <> T.DimensionChksm
)

SELECT * INTO #DELTA FROM DELTA;


UPDATE TGT
SET 
ValidEndDttm=getdate(),  
InsertDttm=getdate()
FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit  TGT
JOIN #DELTA DELTA ON TGT.UserID = DELTA.UserID AND TGT.UserEmail = DELTA.UserEmail AND TGT.BankID = DELTA.BankID AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = DELTA.SourceSystemCode
WHERE ValidEndDttm = '9999-12-31' AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE';


INSERT INTO dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit (Id,UserID,UserName,UserGroup,UserEmail,BankID,SourceSystemCode,Datalayer,ValidStartDttm,ValidEndDttm,WorkFlowId,TaskRunId,InsertDttm,DimensionChksm)
SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SRC.UserID) + (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ID),0) ID FROM  dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit) Id
,SRC.UserID
,SRC.UserName
,SRC.UserGroup
,SRC.UserEmail
,SRC.BankID
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,SRC.Datalayer
,SRC.ValidStartDttm
,SRC.ValidEndDttm
,SRC.WorkFlowId
,SRC.TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm
,SRC.DimensionChksm
FROM #SRC SRC
WHERE CONCAT(UserID,UserEmail) IN (SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(UserID,UserEmail) FROM #DELTA WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE')
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit B WHERE B.ValidEndDttm = '9999-12-31'
    AND SRC.UserID = B.UserID
    AND SRC.UserName = B.UserName
    AND SRC.UserGroup = B.UserGroup
    AND SRC.UserEmail = B.UserEmail
    AND SRC.BankID = B.BankID
    AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
    AND SRC.Datalayer = B.Datalayer
    AND SRC.DimensionChksm = B.DimensionChksm
);

INSERT INTO dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit (Id,UserID,UserName,UserGroup,UserEmail,BankID,SourceSystemCode,Datalayer,ValidStartDttm,ValidEndDttm,WorkFlowId,TaskRunId,InsertDttm,DimensionChksm)
SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SRC.UserID) + (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ID),0) ID FROM  dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit) Id
,SRC.UserID
,SRC.UserName
,SRC.UserGroup
,SRC.UserEmail
,SRC.BankID
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,SRC.Datalayer
,SRC.ValidStartDttm
,SRC.ValidEndDttm
,SRC.WorkFlowId
,SRC.TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm
,SRC.DimensionChksm
FROM #SRC SRC
WHERE CONCAT(UserID,UserEmail) IN (SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(UserID,UserEmail) FROM #DELTA WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT');

END

 UserEmail varchar(80) NOT NULL

CREATE PROCEDURE DW.SP_RefRowLevelSecurityFilterAudit
AS BEGIN

WITH SRC AS (
    select
UserEmail as UserEmail
,BankSk as BankSk
,BankID as BankID
,SourceSystemCode as SourceSystemCode
,getdate() as ValidStartDttm
,'9999-12-31'	as ValidEndDttm
,isnull(WorkFlowId,0) as WorkFlowId
,isnull(TaskRunId,0) as TaskRunId
,getdate() as InsertDttm
,BINARY_CHECKSUM(UserEmail,BankSk,BankID,SourceSystemCode) as DimensionChksm
     FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurityFilter
)
SELECT * INTO #SRC FROM SRC;

WITH TGT AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT * FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurityFilterAudit WHERE ValidEndDttm = '9999-12-31'
)
, DELTA AS (
    SELECT S.BankSk, S.UserEmail,S.BankID,S.SourceSystemCode, S.DimensionChksm as src_dchksm, T.DimensionChksm as tgt_dchksm,
    CASE WHEN T.DimensionChksm IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
         WHEN S.DimensionChksm <> T.DimensionChksm THEN 'UPDATE'
         ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #SRC S
    LEFT JOIN TGT T ON S.BankSk = T.BankSk AND S.UserEmail = T.UserEmail AND S.BankID = T.BankID  AND S.SourceSystemCode = T.SourceSystemCode 
    WHERE T.DimensionChksm IS NULL OR S.DimensionChksm <> T.DimensionChksm
) 

SELECT * INTO #DELTA FROM DELTA;


UPDATE TGT
SET 
ValidEndDttm=getdate(),  
InsertDttm=getdate()
FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurityFilterAudit  TGT
JOIN #DELTA DELTA ON TGT.BankSk = DELTA.BankSk AND TGT.UserEmail = DELTA.UserEmail AND TGT.BankID = DELTA.BankID AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = DELTA.SourceSystemCode
WHERE ValidEndDttm = '9999-12-31' AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE';


INSERT INTO dw.RefRowLevelSecurityFilterAudit 
SELECT DISTINCT
 SRC.UserEmail
,SRC.BankSk
,SRC.BankID
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,SRC.ValidStartDttm
,SRC.ValidEndDttm
,SRC.WorkFlowId
,SRC.TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm
,SRC.DimensionChksm
FROM #SRC SRC
JOIN #DELTA DLT ON SRC.BankSk = DLT.BankSk AND SRC.UserEmail = DLT.UserEmail AND SRC.BankID = DLT.BankID AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = DLT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE 
DLT.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurityFilterAudit B WHERE B.ValidEndDttm = '9999-12-31'
    AND SRC.UserEmail = B.UserEmail
    AND SRC.BankSk = B.BankSk
    AND SRC.BankID = B.BankID
    AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
    AND SRC.DimensionChksm = B.DimensionChksm
);

INSERT INTO TRUNCATE TABLE dw.RefRowLevelSecurityFilterAudit 
SELECT DISTINCT
 SRC.UserEmail
,SRC.BankSk
,SRC.BankID
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,SRC.ValidStartDttm
,SRC.ValidEndDttm
,SRC.WorkFlowId
,SRC.TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm
,SRC.DimensionChksm
FROM #SRC SRC
JOIN #DELTA DLT ON SRC.BankSk = DLT.BankSk AND SRC.UserEmail = DLT.UserEmail AND SRC.BankID = DLT.BankID AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = DLT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE 
DLT.RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'
;

END
